answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a secure orchard of unique identities, preventing Sybil agents from flooding the network. By tying digital autonomy to biological uniqueness, the protocol forces an attacker into a deep canyon of high operational costs, as they must acquire verifiable human biological data. This mechanism ensures that each node represents a distinct entity, preventing a plume of malicious bots from gaining control through identity mass-generation.
